$comment: Plate frames (catalog kind frame, PlateFrame.tsx): an earned ring drawn round a player's avatar disc on plates, profiles and the locker. After slicing, run `python3 art/fit_rings.py public/career-art/plate-frame/*.webp` so every ring's hole is the same share of the picture (the share LookParts.module.css .framePainted assumes).
style: Avatar frame rings seen straight on, perfectly circular and symmetrical where the subject allows: a decorative ring printed in the accent ink the subject names (a flat solid letterpress ink with its speckle), with fine carved detail in ivory ink. Its centre is a large EMPTY round hole (fully transparent, nothing inside it) whose width is about 70% of the whole piece, so a portrait can show through; the ring and its ornaments live in the band outside the hole and never cross into it. Every ring is the same overall size and fills about 90% of its cell.
spare: a plain thin ivory ring with an empty centre
